title: Corpus report
description: The output of Corpus.Collect: every shard's verdict, product blobs and content hash in task order, and the aggregate over the fleet.

controller.description: The controller version that wrote the report.

drops.description: Documents dropped per rule, summed over the completed shards.

languages.description: Documents out per ISO 639-3 code, summed over the completed shards.

unsupported_languages.description: Documents dropped as language_unsupported, by where they were nearest: the code of a language the pack knows and does not support, past_limit:<code> for a supported language the document lies past the limit of (a language the pack has no profile for, or text too unlike its own), no_profile for text that shares no n-gram with any profile. Sums to the drop language_unsupported; absent from reports of controllers before 0.2.0. Summed over the completed shards.

pdf_in.description: PDF responses the PDF stage took (WARC; present only where a shard met a PDF, like every pdf_* count).

pdf_truncated.description: Of those, the ones the crawler cut short (WARC-Truncated); read all the same.

pdf_extracted.description: PDFs that gave at least one page-range document.

pdf_documents.description: The page-range documents made (url#page=a-b); each also counts in documents_extracted.

pdf_pages_cut.description: Pages longer than a document may be (5,000 words), cut after the last line that fits.

pdf_running_lines.description: Lines removed as running headers and footers.

pdf_fuel.description: Fuel the PDF sandbox burned, counted from each run's _start: the same on every node.

funnel.description: The run's funnel over the completed shards: the records read, the documents extracted, the documents left after the language stage, the line stage and the quality filter, and the documents out (equal to quality); dropped sums the drops by the stage that applies them (extract counts records and PDFs that gave no document, beside the funnel; the others count documents). Absent from reports of controllers before 0.3.0.

output.description: What the run kept on the server: full, or stats_and_hashes (no text, no signatures: text_blob and signatures_blob are "", and Corpus.Dedup refuses the run). Absent from reports of controllers before 0.3.0 (they kept everything).

minhash.description: The MinHash parameters every shard's signatures were made with; absent when no shard has signatures or the shards differ (each shard then says its own), and from reports of controllers before 0.3.0 (the defaults).

text_blob.description: Blob id of the zstd JSON lines, or "".

signatures_blob.description: Blob id of the signatures, or "".

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the uncompressed JSON lines: the identity a re-execution must reproduce.

runtime_target.description: The operating system and architecture the shard ran on, e.g. "linux-x64" ("" from a controller before it was reported). A platform, never a machine.

degree.description: Shards the node processed at once (its cores, bounded by memory): the context of process_ms (0 when not reported).

minhash.description: The MinHash parameters the shard's signatures were made with; present when the shard has signatures (absent from reports of controllers before 0.3.0, whose signatures carry the defaults).

bytes_produced.description: Bytes of the compressed text product; under output stats_and_hashes the size the product had on the node before it was deleted.

wait_ms.description: Time the shard waited on the node for a download slot and a processing slot.

drops.description: Documents dropped per rule; the PDF stage's are pdf_encrypted, pdf_unreadable, pdf_no_pages, pdf_fuel, pdf_memory, pdf_trap, pdf_error, pdf_oversized and pdf_empty.

unsupported_languages.description: Documents dropped as language_unsupported, by where they were nearest: the code of a language the pack knows and does not support, past_limit:<code> for a supported language the document lies past the limit of (a language the pack has no profile for, or text too unlike its own), no_profile for text that shares no n-gram with any profile. Sums to the drop language_unsupported; absent from reports of controllers before 0.2.0.

pdf_in.description: PDF responses the PDF stage took (WARC; present only where a shard met a PDF, like every pdf_* count).

pdf_truncated.description: Of those, the ones the crawler cut short (WARC-Truncated); read all the same.

pdf_extracted.description: PDFs that gave at least one page-range document.

pdf_documents.description: The page-range documents made (url#page=a-b); each also counts in documents_extracted.

pdf_pages_cut.description: Pages longer than a document may be (5,000 words), cut after the last line that fits.

pdf_running_lines.description: Lines removed as running headers and footers.

pdf_fuel.description: Fuel the PDF sandbox burned, counted from each run's _start: the same on every node.

counts.description: Name to count, names in ordinal order.
